current_delta: Agree with lane A that destructive/admin/device operations must remain semantically expressible as typed EffectIntent values; execution authority stays external and opaque.
New adversarial distinction: per-call capability validity != cumulative admissibility. A sequence of individually in-scope constructive effects can exceed a safe aggregate budget.
EffectPermit therefore needs host-side monotone consumption state or an equivalent non-forgeable budget ledger; max_call alone is insufficient.
Permit validity must bind exact intent semantic hash, canonical target, operation class, origin/integrity ancestry, causal epoch/freshness, expiry/revocation and aggregate resource/effect budget.
Origin-bound integrity must survive summarization/tool echo/corroboration; current-producer trust must not erase untrusted ancestry.
Safety should constrain authority/commit, not Turing/general-purpose expressiveness.
